subject: Executive sponsor list & board meeting slot for ACME close plan

Subject: Draft MAP + request to identify exec champions

Emma — thanks again for the demo yesterday.

Per our conversation, I put together a short mutual action plan (attached) that maps milestones, owners, and the evaluation checkpoints we discussed. The two things we need to lock to keep the Q1 close on track:

- Executive sponsor(s) who will attend a single board-level session for the commercial/finance approval (30–45m).
- Confirmation of the internal evaluation window and the date you want Redwood to present the final cost/perf summary.

Can you share who at ACME would be the exec sponsor(s) (name + title + preferred dates in the week of Feb 23–27)? I’ve flagged the MAP items that need sponsor sign-off. I’m copying Steph and Marissa to coordinate the invite and materials.

Attachment: Mutual_Action_Plan_ACME_v2.xlsx (MAP, milestone RACI, 2 pages)

Thanks —

Karthik / Steph — thanks for sending this over. The MAP looks good at a glance. Quick answers:

- Exec sponsor: Michael Tan, VP Finance (will chair the board session). He’s availability-light but can do Feb 24th 10:00–11:00 PT or Feb 25th 14:00–15:00 PT.
- Secondary sponsor: Lina Park, Head of SRE (technical approval) — she prefers Feb 25th mornings.
- Procurement loop: procurement@acme.com will need the contract redlines after the board session.

We’ll review your MAP internally this afternoon and I’ll confirm which slot we can commit to. Please plan for a 30–40 minute executive readout plus 10 minutes for Q&A.

Proposed session (we’ll prepare a 6-slide readout + one short demo clip):
- Feb 25, 10:00–10:40 PT — Exec readout (Michael Tan + Lina Park)
- Core attendees: Michael Tan (VP Finance), Lina Park (Head SRE), Emma Liu (Director), Karthik Iyer (AE), Stephanie Nguyen (Sales Lead)
- Optional: Ben Carter (Solutions), Laura Bennett (Customer Success lead for board logistics)

Action items for ACME:
1) Confirm the Feb 25, 10:00 PT slot (Emma) — blocked tentatively on our side.
2) Share any sensitive evaluation questions you want us to cover specifically in the readout (security, data residency, licensing).
3) Procurement to expect a redline-ready contract within 48 hours after the session.

Attachments: Exec_Roster_ACME.pdf (1 page, exec list + titles), Mutual_Action_Plan_ACME_v2.xlsx

Looping internal ops — Emma just verbally confirmed the 25th in a quick call and asked that we include a short pricing slide that compares the Dedicated vs Hosted cost profile at the projected token volumes. Also: recommend we add a single slide that calls out the rollback/fallback policy in the MAP (what happens if certain perf thresholds aren’t met during eval). Keeps the board comfortable on risk. I’ll draft language and drop it into the live MAP.

I’ll also flag DocuSign after the meeting; procurement@acme.com expects a redline step.

Thanks all — I’ll update the MAP and send the invite once Ben + Laura confirm.
